Beauty, in the details

A Work of Art.In Every Inch.

Look a little closer. Discover the artistry that makes a VASRÉ saree truly exceptional.

Mulberry silk yarn, reeled and dyed in small batches, so the colour deepens and the sheen softens with every wear.

Silver-core zari dipped in gold, woven motif by motif. Its antique finish is what gives the border that quiet, lived-in glow.

Every saree spends weeks on a pit loom in Varanasi. Small irregularities in the weave are the signature of a human hand.
